methods: Select only the row's own named 2022 BUA, NRS 2020 locality (preferred to a multi-place settlement), or NISRA SDL2015 settlement; require strict original-point containment, compatible row type/local type/parent and own literal Wikidata P31/name/code checks where an item exists. Do not use namesake administrative units or containing conurbations. Hold conflicting, missing or ambiguous evidence. Use ONS published rounded-to-five 2021 usual residents, NRS 2020 all-sex/all-age estimates, or NISRA CT0046 exact 2021 usual residents, never sum local authorities or infer a count.
scope_notes: ONS tables 1c/1d exclude London and publish rounded-to-five usual resident counts.
NRS current official index explicitly links mid-2020 as latest. Localities identify individual towns/cities; prefer them over a multi-place settlement.
NISRA CT0046 is exact, uses unchanged SDL2015 boundaries and suppresses small populations.
Civil-parish/community local types and exclusive administrative items are held: this source patch cannot resolve the row scope.

P31 civil-parish plus town/village roles do not preclude a statistical settlement binding where the row local type explicitly denotes the settlement. Scottish lieutenancy and former burgh roles do not replace a current locality binding for a directly classified city/town.
Missing own item is recorded, never filled from another entity. Admission without an item requires an explicit settlement local type and one unique official named boundary.
